summary: High Court scrutiny of hundreds of millions of shekels in coalition transfers approved during Knesset recess; funds remained frozen while the court demanded explanations from the Finance Committee and Finance Ministry.
notes: Freshness recheck adds independent Aug. 25 reporting that the High Court instructed the Knesset Finance Committee and Finance Ministry to explain why the transfers should not be canceled after an earlier freeze over apparent procedural flaws. This remains a systemic/procedural funding case: the source does not make a direct personal finding of wrongdoing against Smotrich, and no final merits ruling/primary order establishing individual responsibility was recovered. Keep Pending; do not attach a systemic failure to the minister by inference.
